name: todo-cli smoke
description: Checks that a model generates a working Node.js 24 CLI todo app. The tests_pass assertion catches test bugs like the phase-34 bare-await pattern.

cases.prompt: Build a Node.js 24 ESM CLI todo app. Commands: add <title>, list, done <id>. Store todos in a JSON file at .todos.json. Put source in src/cli.mjs and src/store.mjs. Put tests in test/cli.test.mjs using node:test and node:assert/strict. Export a default async function from src/cli.mjs that accepts process.argv.
